These small checked-in files support ordinary offline unit tests only. The SAIF is a hand-authored two-lane fixture; its values are not the real Verilator smoke data. `source_provenance.json` records expected metadata for assertions but is not current evidence. The reproducible current-evidence gate lives under `build/reports/d4_activity_binding_20261018/verilator_smoke_native_mock/` and hashes the actual L2 DCP, frozen core, observed hierarchy, binding table, production Tcl, and 14,195-record Verilator SAIF before running the helper with mocked native cell properties.
